newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean LG-Caltex's new CDU starts production.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean LG-Caltex's new CDU starts production.

text.p: South Korea's LG-Caltex Oil Corp, a unit of the LG Group, said on Thursday its new 320 billion won crude distillation unit (CDU) had started production on Wednesday.
The new CDU has a government-licensed production capacity of 220,000 barrels per day (bpd), but a company statement said the unit would be capable of processing 270,000 bpd of crude oil.
"The new CDU will lift (our) total capacity to 650,000 bpd from 400,000 bpd," it said. The company previously had a government licensed capacity of 380,000 bpd.
It said commercial production of the new unit in the winter season would help meet heavy demand for heating oil in winter.
LG-Caltex is a joint venture between LG Group and Caltex Petroleum Corp, itself a joint venture between U.S. oil giants Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
